verdict.rationale: The Titan Security Key is a physical FIDO/U2F hardware authenticator. Subscribing to events via outbound webhooks is outside this product category, and nothing in the evidence shows the key ships any such capability. The probe confirms Titan has no CLI, SDK, API or MCP surface of its own, and fleet management goes through the Google Workspace Admin console, which is a separate product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
